notes: The programme page states the language of this track is Dutch ('taal Nederlands'); it lists an English variant, but that is a separate track not applied here. No page states a tuition fee specific to non-EU students for this programme: the collegegeld pages give only the general 'instellingscollegegeld' of a whole institution, so it is left out. No programme-specific application deadline or document list is stated for this programme; only the general non-EU recommended deadline of 1 May appears (in 'we recommend' wording), which is why it is not listed as a fact.

note.en: A foreign diploma must be validated by Inholland: upload your diploma, transcript and, if needed, a sworn translation before 1 May.
